boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain DeSales University
boards.description: Navigate the late-night landscape of Center Valley with these essential student-accessible spots, from on-campus convenience to regional 24-hour staples.

cards.title: Frankie's Market
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: Visit this on-campus convenience hub for late-night snacks and essentials. It stays open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store and Jimmy John's location within the Dorothy Day Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Frankie's Market is open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; accepts Paw Bucks and meal plans.

cards.title: Wawa
cards.subtitle: Center Valley Parkway
cards.notes: Head to this 24-hour regional staple for custom hoagies and coffee. It is a primary off-campus destination for late-night food runs.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience store and gas station located just off campus, known for its made-to-order food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Wawa locations in the region, including the Center Valley Parkway site, typically operate 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for food and fuel.

cards.title: Sheetz
cards.subtitle: Route 378
cards.notes: Order MTO (Made-To-Order) snacks and meals at any hour. This location serves as a frequent alternative to Wawa for students seeking variety.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience chain offering a wide variety of customizable hot food and beverages.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz provides Made-To-Order food and beverages 24/7/365 at its Bethlehem location near campus.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for walk-in and drive-thru service.

cards.title: AMC Center Valley 16
cards.subtitle: Promenade Saucon Valley
cards.notes: Catch a late-night screening and grab popcorn or hot snacks. Concessions typically remain open until 15 minutes after the final show starts.
cards.short_summary: A premier movie theater at the Promenade Saucon Valley featuring IMAX and an expanded hot food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The theater hosts late-night showtimes with concessions available until shortly after the last movie begins.
cards.source_title: AMC Center Valley 16 | Showtimes & Movie Tickets
cards.access_notes: Concessions typically close 15-20 minutes after the last scheduled showtime starts.

cards.title: Wonder
cards.subtitle: Center Valley Parkway
cards.notes: Order from multiple high-end restaurant menus in one place. This food hall offers delivery and pickup until 11:30 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A modern food hall featuring menus from celebrated chefs, available for late-night pickup or delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Wonder Center Valley is open daily from 10:30 AM to 11:30 PM.
cards.source_title: Wonder Food Delivery in Center Valley
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:30 PM for pickup and delivery orders.

cards.title: White Castle
cards.subtitle: MacArthur Road
cards.notes: Drive to Whitehall for late-night sliders. This location is a destination for students seeking the chain's signature small burgers after midnight.
cards.short_summary: A classic fast-food chain famous for its small, square sliders, operating late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The White Castle on MacArthur Road is open until 3:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM; drive-thru and pickup available.

cards.title: Dunkin'
cards.subtitle: Center Valley Parkway
cards.notes: Grab a late coffee or donut at this nearby location. While not 24 hours, it serves as a reliable evening stop for study fuel.
cards.short_summary: A popular coffee and baked goods chain located near the Promenade Saucon Valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin' locations in the Center Valley area provide evening service for coffee and snacks.
cards.access_notes: Check mobile app for specific daily closing times; typically open until 8:00 PM or 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Red Robin
cards.subtitle: Promenade Saucon Valley
cards.notes: Enjoy gourmet burgers and bottomless fries during late dinner hours. It is a common group dining spot for students on weekend nights.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining restaurant specializing in burgers and family-friendly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Red Robin at Saucon Valley is open until 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Monday-Saturday; 8:00 PM on Sunday.

cards.title: Starlite Diner
cards.subtitle: Route 100
cards.notes: Drive to this classic 24-hour diner for a full breakfast or late-night meal. It is a traditional Lehigh Valley spot for post-event dining.
cards.short_summary: A traditional 24-hour American diner offering a massive menu of comfort food favorites.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starlite Diner is a 24-hour establishment serving the Lehigh Valley area.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: DUC Food Court Grille
cards.subtitle: DeSales University Center
cards.notes: Grab grilled favorites like burgers and cheesesteaks on campus. The Grille station serves as the primary late-afternoon and early-evening hot food source.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall's grill station, offering hot meals through the dinner hour.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grille at the University Center Food Court is open for dinner until 7:30 PM daily.
cards.source_title: University Center Food Court - DeSales Dining!
cards.access_notes: Dinner service ends at 7:30 PM; accepts meal swipes and Paw Bucks.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional hubs and quiet corners where DeSales students actually spend their time, from late-night study lounges to specialized academic centers.

cards.title: Trexler Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Quiet collaboration zones in the campus heart
cards.notes: Reserve a small group study room online for up to two hours. These glass-walled spaces are ideal for finals week or group projects requiring a quiet environment.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated reservable rooms for individual or group study within the main university library.
cards.evidence_claim: Trexler Library offers various study areas from individual cubicles to collaborative study rooms that can be reserved for two-hour blocks.
cards.access_notes: Open to current students with a valid DeSales ID; reservations required for specific rooms.

cards.title: DUC Fireside Computer Lounge
cards.subtitle: A cozy tech-equipped hub for commuters and residents
cards.notes: Located near the food court, this lounge features a fireplace and computer stations, making it a popular spot for quick emails between classes or warming up in winter.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lounge in the DUC featuring a fireplace, computer access, and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The DeSales University Center (DUC) includes a fireside computer lounge and outdoor patio situated between the gym and Dooling Hall.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during University Center operating hours.

cards.title: Centaur Lounge
cards.subtitle: A nod to history in the student union
cards.notes: Visit this renovated space to see the Allentown College wall. It's a prime spot for socializing, featuring pool tables and proximity to the esports arena.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in the Dorothy Day Student Union that honors the university's former identity as Allentown College.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centaur Lounge in the Dorothy Day Student Union includes the Allentown College wall and serves as a social hub near the esports arena.
cards.source_title: Take a Tour of the New Centaur Student Lounge
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 to all students with ID access.

cards.title: The Pulse Café Lounge
cards.subtitle: Modern study space for healthcare and business majors
cards.notes: Grab a custom salad and find a seat in the lounge area. The building's green architecture and panoramic views make it a refreshing alternative to the library.
cards.short_summary: A modern cafe and student lounge area located within the Gambet Center for Business and Healthcare Education.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gambet Center features the Pulse Café, student lounge space, and smart classrooms with panoramic views of the campus.
cards.source_title: The Gambet Center for Business & Healthcare - DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; cafe hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Skylight Lounge
cards.subtitle: The academic heart of campus
cards.notes: Surrounded by classrooms, this lounge is the go-to for a Starbucks coffee or a quick study session between lectures in the university's main academic building.
cards.short_summary: A central lounge in Dooling Hall featuring natural light from a skylight and a cafe serving Starbucks products.
cards.evidence_claim: Dooling Hall features the Skylight Lounge, which serves Starbucks coffee and light fare, surrounded by academic classrooms.
cards.source_title: Welcome to Dooling Hall, DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Dooling Hall's academic hours.

cards.title: John Compardo Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: The primary campus workout destination
cards.notes: Head to Billera Hall for the largest weight room on campus. It's equipped with squat racks, free weights, and a full cardio section for student use.
cards.short_summary: The main university fitness facility located within Billera Hall, featuring extensive weight and cardio equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The John Compardo Fitness Center in Billera Hall is the largest on campus and features weight machines, squat racks, and cardio equipment.
cards.source_title: Fitness Centers - Facilities - DeSales University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open to students with ID; hours typically include late nights until 11 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: A dedicated home base for non-resident students
cards.notes: Located next to Jimmy John's, this lounge offers a kitchenette with a microwave and fridge, plus plenty of charging outlets for long days on campus.
cards.short_summary: A specialized lounge for commuter students in the Dorothy Day Student Union featuring a kitchenette and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: A new commuter lounge in the Dorothy Day Student Union features a kitchenette with a fridge, sink, microwave, and coffee maker.
cards.source_title: What's New on Campus? Commuter Lounge, Labuda Expansion, and More
cards.access_notes: Primarily for commuter students; accessible 24/7 with student ID.

cards.entity_name: Labuda Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: TV/Film Tiered Viewing Room
cards.subtitle: A professional screening space for student work
cards.notes: This 100-seat tiered room is where TV/film students showcase their projects. It's a high-tech spot for viewing the latest student-produced content.
cards.short_summary: A specialized screening room in the Labuda Center used for displaying student TV and film projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Labuda Center expansion includes a 100-seat tiered viewing room for TV/film students to display their projects.
cards.source_title: What's New on Campus? Commuter Lounge, Labuda Expansion, and More
cards.access_notes: Access typically restricted to performing arts students or during scheduled screenings.

cards.title: Veterans Lounge
cards.subtitle: Support and community for student veterans
cards.notes: Recently expanded, this lounge provides a private space for veterans to study and connect, featuring computer access and comfortable seating.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge in Dooling Hall providing resources and a social space for the university's veteran community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Veterans Lounge in Dooling Hall has doubled in size to accommodate expanded seating and additional computers.
cards.source_title: What's New on Campus? Commuter Lounge, Labuda Expansion, and More
cards.access_notes: Dedicated for use by student veterans and military-affiliated students.

cards.title: Connelly Chapel
cards.subtitle: A peaceful sanctuary for reflection
cards.notes: Open for daily Mass and quiet prayer, the chapel is a central landmark for spiritual life. Check the schedule for weekly Adoration hours.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus chapel serving as a site for religious services and quiet personal reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Connelly Chapel is a central campus location for spiritual life, offering Adoration and Confessions at scheduled times.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for services; students can access for quiet prayer during open hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social activities and public-access spaces at DeSales University, from 24/7 student lounges to scenic campus trails and recreational facilities.

cards.title: 24/7 Student Lounge Access
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: Access pool tables, ping-pong, and lounge seating 24/7 with a student ID. This central hub is the primary social space for late-night student gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour student hub featuring recreational games and lounge spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dorothy Day Student Union is open 24/7 to all students and features pool tables, ping-pong, and television.
cards.source_title: The Dorothy Day Student Union: Food, Fun, & Student Resources - YouTube
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students; public access typically follows standard business hours.

cards.title: Play 18 Holes of Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: DeSales University Campus
cards.notes: Navigate an 18-hole course featuring a mix of open and technical wooded fairways. The course is free to play; bring your own discs or borrow from student groups.
cards.short_summary: A full 18-hole disc golf course integrated into the campus landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: DeSales University offers a full disc golf course outdoors, and the university has hosted free clinics for students and community members.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; parking is available near the Dorothy Day Student Union.

cards.title: Public Research and Study
cards.subtitle: Trexler Library First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize designated public access computers for research or find a quiet study nook. Community members can obtain a library card with a valid ID for borrowing.
cards.short_summary: The campus library offers public-access computers and diverse study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Community members may access library databases and the internet from designated Public Access Computers located on the first floor.
cards.access_notes: Public access is available during standard library hours; check the website for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Attend Daily or Sunday Mass
cards.subtitle: Connelly Chapel
cards.notes: Join the campus community for daily Mass at noon or Sunday evening services. All are welcome to attend these spiritual gatherings in the heart of campus.
cards.short_summary: A central campus chapel offering regular religious services open to all.
cards.evidence_claim: Daily Mass is held at Connelly Chapel on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at noon, and Sunday Mass is held at 10:30am and 5:00pm.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry & Spiritual Life - DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled services and private prayer during building hours.

cards.title: Jog the Saucon Rail Trail
cards.subtitle: Campus Trail Connection
cards.notes: Access this scenic, mostly flat rail trail directly from campus for running or walking. The trail follows a former railroad corridor through local green spaces.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use trail accessible from campus for outdoor recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saucon Rail Trail loop is a popular jogging route from DeSales University, offering a mostly flat and well-maintained surface.
cards.source_title: The best running trails around Desales University | Komoot
cards.access_notes: Public trail accessible year-round from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Workout at Billera Hall
cards.subtitle: Billera Hall
cards.notes: Students can use the expansive weight room and cardio equipment at no extra charge. Bring your student ID for entry to the university's main athletic facility.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary fitness facility available to the student population.
cards.evidence_claim: The Compardo Fitness Center and Recreation Courts are available to the general student population at Billera Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7am-11pm with varied weekend hours; student ID required.

cards.title: Join Free Student Socials
cards.subtitle: Various Campus Locations
cards.notes: Participate in free events like Quizzo, karaoke nights, and yoga classes organized by the Campus Activities Board. Check the DSU Weekly for the latest schedule.
cards.short_summary: Regularly scheduled free social and wellness events for the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Activities Board hosts various free events including Quizzo, Destress Yoga, and Karaoke Night for students.
cards.access_notes: Events are typically restricted to current students with a valid DSU ID.

cards.title: Late Night Study Sessions
cards.subtitle: Gambet Center for Business and Healthcare
cards.notes: Take advantage of extended weekend hours in this modern academic building. It offers quiet spaces and collaborative areas for group projects and individual study.
cards.short_summary: An academic building with extended hours for student study needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Access to Gambet Center has been extended to 9:00 PM on Fridays and from 8:00 AM on Saturdays and Sundays to support student study needs.
cards.source_title: Dooling and Gambet Access Hours Extended on Weekends - DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM on Fridays; weekend access starts at 8:00 AM.

cards.title: Pick-up Basketball or Volleyball
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Recreation Area
cards.notes: Gather friends for a game on the outdoor basketball or sand volleyball courts. These facilities are open for casual use by the student community during daylight hours.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor courts for basketball and volleyball available for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoors, there are two basketball courts and two sand volleyball courts available for student recreation.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; use is first-come, first-served unless reserved for intramurals.

cards.title: Watch a Bulldog Soccer Match
cards.subtitle: Soccer Stadium
cards.notes: Cheer on the men's and women's soccer teams from the bleachers or the grass seating area. Regular season home games are typically free for students to attend.
cards.short_summary: A campus stadium for watching varsity soccer games.
cards.evidence_claim: The soccer complex features bleacher seating for 500+ fans and grass seating, making it an easy walk for students to enjoy a game.
cards.source_title: Soccer Fields - Facilities - DeSales University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Access is free for most regular-season home athletic events for students.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover a range of study environments across the DeSales University campus, from high-tech collaborative rooms to quiet individual cubicles and 24-hour lounges.

cards.title: Collaborative Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Trexler Library
cards.notes: Reserve these rooms for up to two hours daily using your university email. They are ideal for group projects and collaborative sessions.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located within the Trexler Library for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Each individual may reserve a study room for up to two hours per day. Reservations may be made up to thirty days in advance.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current DeSales students, faculty, and staff; reservation required via university email.

cards.title: Therapeutic Calming Space
cards.subtitle: Trexler Library
cards.notes: A specialized room designed for a therapeutic and calming study experience, provided in partnership with Student Accessibility.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated sensory-friendly space in Trexler Library designed to provide a calming environment for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sensory Room 2.0 is provided by the Trexler Library in partnership with the Office of Student Accessibility. It was designed to provide a therapeutic, calming space.
cards.access_notes: Available for student use within the library; check in at the front desk for access details.

cards.title: Cozy Tech Hub
cards.subtitle: DeSales University Center (DUC)
cards.notes: Located in the central campus hub, this lounge offers a comfortable atmosphere with computer access and proximity to dining.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable computer lounge featuring a fireplace, located in the DeSales University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: At the DUC you'll find a large food court, fireside computer lounge, and outdoor patio.
cards.access_notes: Open during University Center hours; wireless internet is available throughout the building.

cards.title: Modern Academic Lounge
cards.subtitle: Gambet Center
cards.notes: A modern space within the healthcare and business building, perfect for studying between classes near the Pulse Café.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge space located in the LEED-certified Gambet Center for Business and Healthcare Education.
cards.evidence_claim: The building features... Student Lounge Space, and a divisible 200 seat Lecture Hall.
cards.source_title: DeSales University Gambet Center - Breslin Architects
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; features panoramic views of the campus.

cards.title: 24-Hour Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: This 24-hour lounge provides a reliable late-night spot for studying and group meetings with computer workstations.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour student lounge in the Dorothy Day Student Union equipped for studying and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Residence Life Lounge: A 24-hour student lounge available for studying, socializing, group meetings, and student programs.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day for student use; includes six computer workstations and a network printer.

cards.title: Commuter-Focused Workspace
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: Specifically designed for commuters, this lounge features charging areas and a kitchenette for long study days.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge for commuter students featuring study seating and charging stations.
cards.evidence_claim: The new commuter lounge... features a kitchenette with a fridge, sink, microwave, and coffee maker, as well as expanded seating and new charging areas.
cards.source_title: What's New on Campus? Commuter Lounge, Labuda Expansion, and More
cards.access_notes: Located next to Jimmy John's in the Dorothy Day Student Union.

cards.title: Sunlit Academic Spot
cards.subtitle: Dooling Hall
cards.notes: Study under natural light in the heart of the academic building, with easy access to coffee and light snacks.
cards.short_summary: A central lounge in Dooling Hall featuring natural skylight and nearby food services.
cards.evidence_claim: Classrooms surround the Skylight Lounge, which serves Starbucks coffee, tea, and light fare.
cards.source_title: Welcome to Dooling Hall, DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; central to many campus administrative offices.

cards.title: Dedicated Veteran Space
cards.subtitle: Dooling Hall
cards.notes: A recently expanded space for student veterans, offering computers and comfortable seating for focused work.
cards.short_summary: An expanded lounge in Dooling Hall specifically for student veterans to study and connect.
cards.evidence_claim: In Dooling Hall, the Veterans Lounge has doubled in size to accommodate expanded seating, additional computers, a receptionist desk, and a glass entryway.
cards.source_title: What's New on Campus? Commuter Lounge, Labuda Expansion, and More
cards.access_notes: Located in Dooling Hall; specifically designated for the veteran student community.

cards.title: Quiet Solo Study
cards.subtitle: Trexler Library
cards.notes: For those needing deep focus, these cubicles offer a traditional quiet environment away from group distractions.
cards.short_summary: Individual study cubicles located throughout Trexler Library for quiet, independent work.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Spaces — various areas to meet your needs from individual cubicles to collaborate study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis during library operating hours.

cards.title: 24-Hour Social Study
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: A 24-hour space that balances study with recreation, featuring TVs and games for breaks between sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour common area in the Dorothy Day Student Union used for both study and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Open 24 hours a day, the Commons offers students flat-screen TV's, free pool, ping-pong, table soccer, air hockey, and board games.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day; located within the Dorothy Day Student Union.

cards.title: The Main Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Station Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk or drive this primary campus artery to reach the University's main entrance and the nearby Upper Saucon Township community park.
cards.short_summary: The primary access road for the DeSales University campus and local residential areas.
cards.evidence_claim: DeSales University is located at 2755 Station Avenue, Center Valley, PA 18034.

cards.entity_name: The Promenade Shops at Saucon Valley
cards.title: Premier Lifestyle Center
cards.subtitle: Center Valley Parkway
cards.notes: Visit this open-air mall for dining, a 16-screen AMC movie theater, and seasonal community events just minutes from campus.
cards.short_summary: An upscale outdoor shopping and entertainment destination on Center Valley Parkway.
cards.evidence_claim: The Promenade Shops at Saucon Valley is an outdoor lifestyle center featuring fashion stores, a movie theater, and restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typical hours 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, though theater and restaurants stay open later.

cards.title: Historic Borough Center

cards.title: Essential Retail Hub

cards.notes: Stop by this shopping center for grocery needs and quick-service dining options along the busy Route 309 corridor.
cards.short_summary: A retail plaza featuring grocery stores and services located on Route 309.
cards.evidence_claim: Saucon Valley Square is a shopping center located on Route 309 in Center Valley.
cards.source_title: Promenade Saucon Valley | Discover Lehigh Valley
cards.access_notes: Public shopping center; individual store hours vary.

cards.title: Campus Perimeter Route
cards.subtitle: Landis Mill Road
cards.notes: Travel this road to access the university's athletic fields and the scenic cross-country course on the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A perimeter road bordering the DeSales campus and its primary athletic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Landis Mill Road is a key road name bordering the DeSales University campus map.
cards.access_notes: Public roadway; athletic field access may be restricted during private events.

cards.title: Athletic Complex Access
cards.subtitle: Preston Lane Corridor
cards.notes: Follow Preston Lane to reach Billera Hall and the university's major outdoor sports stadiums and practice fields.
cards.short_summary: A road providing direct access to the university's gymnasium and athletic complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Preston Lane provides access to Billera Hall and the university's athletic fields.
cards.access_notes: Public roadway; university parking lots along the lane require permits.

cards.title: Historic Valley Route
cards.subtitle: Old Philadelphia Pike
cards.notes: Drive this historic route to see the rural landscape of Center Valley and connect to nearby Upper Saucon businesses.
cards.short_summary: A historic north-south road running through the heart of Center Valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Philadelphia Pike is a major local road serving the Center Valley area near the university.
cards.access_notes: Public roadway accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Local Dining District
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit Hellertown's Main Street for a variety of local restaurants and cafes popular with the university community.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial street in Hellertown, known for its local eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: Hellertown offers various dining options like Pints & Pies and Taste of Italy within 15-20 minutes of campus.
cards.source_title: Recommendations for fun places near DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Public borough street; restaurant hours vary.

cards.title: Stabler Pathways District
cards.subtitle: Corporate Parkway Corridor
cards.notes: Walk or bike the trails in this professional district, which hosts major local employers and the Stabler Pathways network.
cards.short_summary: A professional corridor featuring corporate offices and recreational walking paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Corporate Parkway is home to major businesses like Olympus and is part of the Stabler Pathways directory.

cards.title: Historic Lanark District
cards.subtitle: Lanark Road Corridor
cards.notes: See the historic Lanark building and explore the small businesses located at this key intersection near the university.
cards.short_summary: A road corridor featuring historic buildings and local professional services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lanark is a coworking space located in a historic building in Center Valley.
cards.source_title: The Lanark — Center Valley's Newest Coworking Space
cards.access_notes: Public roadway; business access by appointment or membership.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Rooted in Salesian values, DeSales University traditions blend Catholic heritage with a tight-knit community spirit, from holiday feasts to Shakespearean summers.

cards.title: The Character U Welcome
cards.subtitle: First-Year Orientation Tradition
cards.notes: Incoming students are officially welcomed into the Character U program during orientation to begin their four-year journey of Salesian character development.
cards.short_summary: Character U is a signature four-year program at DeSales that begins during first-year orientation, focusing on the development of the whole person.
cards.evidence_claim: The Character U program is a core part of the first-year student orientation at DeSales University, as described in official university student life materials.
cards.source_title: Student Activities and Involvement - DeSales University
cards.access_notes: This tradition is specifically for incoming first-year students during their orientation week.

cards.title: The DUCsgiving Feast
cards.subtitle: Annual Thanksgiving Tradition
cards.notes: Students, faculty, and staff gather in the DeSales University Center (DUC) for a massive community Thanksgiving dinner before the holiday break.
cards.short_summary: DUCsgiving is an annual community-wide Thanksgiving dinner held in the DeSales University Center, often described as 'Friendsgiving to the max.'
cards.evidence_claim: DeSales University hosts an annual 'DUCsgiving' dinner for the campus community, often paired with the Christmas tree lighting ceremony.
cards.source_title: Tis the Season: DeSales Celebrates Holidays With DUCSgiving, Tree Lighting
cards.access_notes: Held annually in November at the DeSales University Center.

cards.title: The Campus Mall Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Holiday Season Kickoff
cards.notes: The community gathers on the campus mall for a blessing and lighting of the university Christmas tree, featuring performances by the chorale and dance teams.
cards.short_summary: The annual Christmas Tree Lighting is a festive tradition where the DeSales community gathers on the mall to celebrate the start of the holiday season.
cards.evidence_claim: The tree lighting and blessing on the campus mall is a documented annual tradition at DeSales University.
cards.source_title: DeSales Kicks Off Holiday Season with DUCsgiving, Tree Lighting Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Open to all students, faculty, and staff on the campus mall.

cards.title: Salesian Heritage Week
cards.subtitle: Celebrating St. Francis de Sales
cards.notes: A week of lectures, forums, and a special Mass dedicated to the legacy and teachings of the university's patron, St. Francis de Sales.
cards.short_summary: Heritage Week is an annual series of events at DeSales University that celebrates the spiritual and intellectual legacy of St. Francis de Sales.
cards.evidence_claim: Heritage Week is an annual event series sponsored by the Salesian Center for Faith & Culture at DeSales University.
cards.source_title: About the Salesian Center - DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Events are typically held in the DeSales University Center and Connelly Chapel.

cards.title: Summer at the Labuda Center
cards.subtitle: Professional Theatre Residency
cards.notes: Every summer, professional actors descend on campus for the Pennsylvania Shakespeare Festival, a tradition of world-class theatre since 1992.
cards.short_summary: The Pennsylvania Shakespeare Festival is a professional theatre company in residence at DeSales University, producing multiple plays each summer.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pennsylvania Shakespeare Festival has been a professional theatre residency on the DeSales campus since its founding in 1992.
cards.access_notes: Performances take place in the Labuda Center for the Performing Arts; tickets are required for shows.

cards.title: The Bulldog Bash
cards.subtitle: Accepted Students Day Tradition
cards.notes: Accepted students celebrate their future at DeSales with a high-energy event featuring prizes, food, and meetings with future classmates.
cards.short_summary: Bulldog Bash is the signature celebration for accepted students to experience the DeSales community before officially enrolling.
cards.evidence_claim: Bulldog Bash is an annual event for accepted students at DeSales University, featuring giveaways and campus life introductions.
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to accepted students and their families.

cards.title: The Class Pint Glass
cards.subtitle: Graduation Giving Tradition
cards.notes: Graduating seniors who contribute to the class gift receive a commemorative pint glass etched with their graduation year.
cards.short_summary: The Senior Class Gift program is a tradition where graduating students receive a commemorative pint glass in exchange for a donation to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Seniors who donate $26 or more to the Senior Class Gift receive a commemorative DSU pint glass.
cards.source_title: Senior Class Gift - The DeSales Fund
cards.access_notes: Available to graduating seniors during their final semester.

cards.title: The Graduation Vigil
cards.subtitle: Commencement Weekend Tradition
cards.notes: Graduates and families gather in Billera Hall for a final Mass together, a spiritual bookend to their four years at DeSales.
cards.short_summary: The Baccalaureate Mass is a significant spiritual tradition held in Billera Hall during Commencement weekend for graduates and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baccalaureate Mass is a traditional part of the DeSales University graduation weekend, often held in Billera Hall.
cards.access_notes: Held in Billera Hall; open to graduates and their guests.

cards.title: Octoberfest on the Mall
cards.subtitle: Fall Community Festival
cards.notes: Students celebrate the autumn season on the campus mall with food, games, and music during this long-standing fall tradition.
cards.short_summary: Octoberfest is a favorite fall tradition at DeSales, bringing students together on the campus mall for seasonal festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Octoberfest is listed as an annual tradition coordinated by the Office of Student Engagement and Leadership at DeSales.
cards.source_title: Student Activities and Involvement - DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the campus mall in October.

cards.title: The 'Live Jesus' Maxim
cards.subtitle: Salesian Spiritual Tradition
cards.notes: The phrase 'Live Jesus' (Vive Jésus) is the spiritual motto of the university, appearing on campus signage and integrated into daily life.
cards.short_summary: 'Live Jesus' is the central spiritual maxim of St. Francis de Sales and serves as the guiding principle for the DeSales University community.
cards.evidence_claim: The maxim 'Live Jesus' is a foundational part of Salesian spirituality at DeSales University, used in campus ministry and university communications.
cards.access_notes: The motto is visible throughout campus and used in university ceremonies.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at DeSales University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A curated sequence for new Bulldogs to navigate their first weekend on campus, from orientation traditions to late-night snacks and recreation.

cards.title: Join Your Orientation Pod
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide
cards.notes: Meet your assigned Pod and student leaders to begin the Character U program. These small groups are designed to help you build your first campus connections through team activities.
cards.short_summary: New students are placed into Pods to compete and bond during the multi-day orientation program.
cards.evidence_claim: During Orientation you will be placed in 1 of 8 Pods and compete for the coveted prize.
cards.access_notes: Required for all first-year students during the designated orientation weekend.

cards.title: Brunch at the DUC
cards.subtitle: DeSales University Center
cards.notes: Visit the DUC for a weekend brunch featuring rotating breakfast sandwiches and pancakes. It is the primary dining hub for resident students using meal swipes.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall offering multiple food stations and scenic views of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The DUC Food Court is open Saturday-Sunday for brunch from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday and Sunday for brunch starting at 10:00 AM.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Station Avenue
cards.notes: Explore the library's various zones, from individual cubicles to collaborative study rooms. It's a quiet retreat for planning your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The central academic resource center providing study spaces, computers, and research assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: Trexler Library offers various areas from individual cubicles to collaborative study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Check current semester hours; typically closed on summer weekends but open during the academic year.

cards.title: Shoot Hoops at Billera Hall
cards.subtitle: Athletics Complex
cards.notes: Use the alumni recreation courts for basketball or volleyball. It is the main hub for varsity sports and general student recreation.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary athletic facility housing gymnasiums and recreation courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Students wishing to use the rec courts for basketball or volleyball must sign up via Calendly.
cards.source_title: Billera Hall Gymnasium - DeSales University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM for general student use.

cards.title: Quick Workout at Dorothy Day
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: Located in the heart of campus, this center is accessible 24/7 for students looking for a convenient workout between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located fitness facility featuring cardio and resistance machines.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dorothy Day Fitness Center is centrally located and open 24/7 to all students.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 with a valid student ID card.

cards.title: Late Night at Frankie's
cards.subtitle: Dorothy Day Student Union
cards.notes: Grab a late-night snack or essential supplies at this on-campus market. It stays open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A convenience market located within the student union offering snacks and grab-and-go items.
cards.evidence_claim: Frankie's Market is open Friday and Saturday from 11:00 AM to 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on weekends; accepts Paw Bucks and meal plan options.

cards.title: Attend Sunday Mass
cards.subtitle: Center Campus
cards.notes: Join the campus community for a Salesian service. The chapel is a central point for spiritual life and reflection for students of all faiths.
cards.short_summary: The university's main chapel hosting regular Catholic Mass and spiritual events.
cards.evidence_claim: Connelly Chapel is listed as a key location for spiritual life and student services.
cards.access_notes: Sunday Mass times are typically posted on the Campus Ministry website.

cards.title: Coffee at the Gambet Center
cards.subtitle: Gambet Center
cards.notes: Stop by the Pulse Café for a custom salad or light fare. It's a modern spot to relax inside the LEED-certified healthcare and business building.
cards.short_summary: A cafe located in the Gambet Center offering healthy food options and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pulse Café serves light fare and custom salads in the Gambet Center.
cards.source_title: College of Healthcare Professions | DeSales University
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday-Friday; check weekend availability during special orientation events.

cards.entity_name: Labuda Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Catch a Performance
cards.subtitle: Station Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the home of Act 1 productions to see where theater, dance, and film students showcase their work throughout the academic year.
cards.short_summary: The university's performing arts hub featuring multiple theaters and studios.
cards.evidence_claim: The Labuda Center features the 473-seat Main Stage Theatre and the 187-seat Schubert Theatre.
cards.access_notes: Box office hours vary; student tickets are often available for Act 1 shows.

cards.title: Play a Round of Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Recreation
cards.notes: Grab some friends and head to the full disc golf course located on the university's 500-acre scenic campus for some outdoor fun.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus disc golf course available for student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoors, there are multiple picnic areas and a full disc golf course.
cards.access_notes: Open during daylight hours; students should bring their own discs.
